b2-pszichoanalizis-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Budapest Society
b2-pszichoanalizis-01.scenario: At a psychology evening in Budapest, a guest named Judit asks who founded the Hungarian Psychoanalytical Society and what has to develop between doctor and patient for the patient to improve.
b2-pszichoanalizis-01.prompt: Tell Judit who founded the society and when, and what develops in the consulting room.
cues: Say who founded the society and when
Say what develops between doctor and patient
b2-pszichoanalizis-01.target: Ferenczi Sándor 1913-ban megalapította a Magyarországi Pszichoanalitikai Egyesületet. A rendelőben őszinte bizalom alakul ki, és a páciens állapota javul.
b2-pszichoanalizis-01.english: Sándor Ferenczi founded the Hungarian Psychoanalytical Society in 1913. In the consulting room sincere trust develops, and the patient's condition improves.
b2-pszichoanalizis-01.canDo: I can explain how Sándor Ferenczi founded the Hungarian Psychoanalytical Society in 1913 and made Budapest a hub of depth psychology.

b2-pszichoanalizis-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Writers and Analysts
b2-pszichoanalizis-02.scenario: In a Budapest café, a literature student named Dóra asks how the Nyugat writers faced their own anxieties and what Kosztolányi set out to do in his novels.
b2-pszichoanalizis-02.prompt: Tell Dóra how the writers dealt with their anxieties and what Kosztolányi undertook.
cues: Say how the writers dealt with their anxieties
Say what Kosztolányi undertook in his novels
b2-pszichoanalizis-02.target: Az írók bátran szembenéztek a szorongásaikkal. Kosztolányi az elfojtott érzelmek ábrázolására vállalkozott.
b2-pszichoanalizis-02.english: The writers bravely faced their anxieties. Kosztolányi undertook to portray repressed emotions.
b2-pszichoanalizis-02.canDo: I can describe the unique alliance between Sándor Ferenczi and the modernist writers of Nyugat (Ignotus, Kosztolányi, Karinthy, Csáth, Attila József).

b2-pszichoanalizis-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Doctor as Medicine
b2-pszichoanalizis-03.scenario: At a medical students' evening in Budapest, a student named Bence asks what Bálint Mihály taught about doctors and how a Bálint group works.
b2-pszichoanalizis-03.prompt: Tell Bence what Bálint's best-known thesis says and what the doctors do in a Bálint group.
cues: Say what the doctor is, according to Bálint
Say how the group members relate to each other
b2-pszichoanalizis-03.target: Bálint Mihály szerint a leggyakrabban felírt „gyógyszer” maga az orvos. A Bálint-csoportban az orvosok egymásra hangolódnak, és belehelyezkednek a beteg helyzetébe.
b2-pszichoanalizis-03.english: According to Mihály Bálint, the most frequently prescribed 'medicine' is the doctor himself. In a Balint group the doctors attune to one another and put themselves in the patient's position.
b2-pszichoanalizis-03.canDo: I can explain how Michael Balint's (Bálint Mihály) groups for doctors put the doctor-patient relationship at the centre of care.

b2-pszichoanalizis-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Apartment Seminars
b2-pszichoanalizis-04.scenario: At an exhibition in Budapest about the apartment seminars, a visitor named Gábor asks what happened to psychoanalysis in 1949 and how the tradition survived.
b2-pszichoanalizis-04.prompt: Tell Gábor what happened to the society in 1949 and where the tradition survived.
cues: Say what happened to the society in 1949
Say where the tradition was preserved
b2-pszichoanalizis-04.target: 1949-ben az egyesület feloszlott, de a hagyomány a magánlakásokban megőrződött. 1989-ben az egyesület újjászerveződött.
b2-pszichoanalizis-04.english: In 1949 the society was dissolved, but the tradition survived in private apartments. In 1989 the society was reorganised.
b2-pszichoanalizis-04.canDo: I can explain how psychoanalysis was banned as 'bourgeois pseudoscience' in 1949, survived in private apartments around Imre Hermann, and was rehabilitated in the 1980s–1990s.

b2-pszichoanalizis-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Flow in the Piano Lesson
b2-pszichoanalizis-05.scenario: In a Budapest music school, a piano teacher named Márta asks what Csíkszentmihályi means by flow and when it comes about.
b2-pszichoanalizis-05.prompt: Tell Márta when flow comes about and what happens to the sense of time.
cues: Say what happens to the sense of time
b2-pszichoanalizis-05.target: Csíkszentmihályi szerint a flow akkor jön létre, amikor a kihívás és a tudás egyensúlyba kerül. Az alkotó belefeledkezik a munkába, és megszűnik számára az időérzék.
b2-pszichoanalizis-05.english: According to Csíkszentmihályi, flow comes about when the challenge and the skill are in balance. The creator loses themselves in the work, and the sense of time ceases.
b2-pszichoanalizis-05.canDo: I can explain Mihály Csíkszentmihályi's concept of 'Flow' (áramlatélmény) and positive psychology.

b2-pszichoanalizis-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From Ferenczi to Flow
b2-pszichoanalizis-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a course in Budapest, a guest named Zsófi asks you to sum up the story from Ferenczi to Csíkszentmihályi.
b2-pszichoanalizis-consolidation.prompt: Tell Zsófi what Ferenczi founded, what Bálint created in London and what Csíkszentmihályi studied.
cues: Say what Bálint created in London
b2-pszichoanalizis-consolidation.target: Ferenczi Sándor 1913-ban megalapította az egyesületet, Bálint Mihály pedig Londonban létrehozta a Bálint-csoportokat. Csíkszentmihályi az áramlatélményt kutatta.
b2-pszichoanalizis-consolidation.english: In 1913 Sándor Ferenczi founded the society, and Mihály Bálint created the Balint groups in London. Csíkszentmihályi studied the flow experience.
b2-pszichoanalizis-consolidation.canDo: I can trace the history of Hungarian psychology from Sándor Ferenczi and the literary cafés of Budapest to Michael Balint and Mihály Csíkszentmihályi.
